* '''Original''' ([[Deployment Orders]]): Virtual Block 6.2 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 6.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy made 15 December 2009), page 2, slip 206. Once per turn, may use 1 Force: reveal a [Theed Palace] vehicle (or Landing Craft) from hand to ▲ a [Presence] droid pilot (or vice versa), and deploy both simultaneously. (Immune to Alter.)” Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-06-Deployment_Orders.png]]) prints slip number “2 • 06” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-deploymentorders-pre.gif]]) prints: “Deploy on table. If your Landing Craft just landed, you may use 1 Force to ▼ a [Presence] droid or Neimoidian aboard. Once per turn, may use 1 Force: reveal a [Theed Palace] vehicle (or Landing Craft) from hand to ▲ a [Presence] droid pilot (or vice versa), and deploy both simultaneously. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “you” is added (“landed, you may use 1 Force”). The same image is in Lee Edwards' V-kit, committed on 9 December 2009<ref name="vkit-2009">Lee Edwards' V-kit, [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit-legacy/tree/81e004826e5697f45d10c4330f78ff8136dae46f/public/images/vslips swccgvkit-legacy <code>public/images/vslips</code>] (commit 81e0048, migrated from svn on 28 May 2010; the <code>.svn/entries</code> files record svn r1 committed 2009-12-09T05:41:52Z for these slips). The file <code>virtual6.2-dark/deploymentorders.png</code> is the same image as the Players Committee card image (same words and slip number), compared by eye on 11 November 2026.</ref>, so it was made by then. The card list carries no errata stamp for it, so it is placed at that proven upper bound, “by 9 December 2009”, right after the release sheet (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image with no firmer date is placed at its proven upper bound); it may be older. The PC website's image folder carries the same file with the server date 25 February 2013, a later bulk upload of the unchanged image. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and set mark) and prints slip number “2 • 06” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Deployment Orders (Errata 2)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1262_6">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock6Type (Virtual Block 6 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “Deploy on table. If your Landing Craft just landed, you may use 1 Force to ▼ a [Presence] droid or Neimoidian aboard. Once per turn, may use 1 Force; reveal a [Theed Palace] vehicle (or Landing Craft) from hand to ▲ a [Presence] droid pilot (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' the colon after “may use 1 Force” becomes a semicolon, and the comma after “(or vice versa)” is dropped. The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Deployment Orders (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 25)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=25 Internet Archive]</ref>, slip [[:File:VL-history-1262-6-front-master.png]]: “Deploy on table. If your Landing Craft just landed, may use 1 Force to ▼ a [Presence] droid or Neimoidian aboard. Once per turn, may use 1 Force: reveal a [Theed Palace] vehicle (or Landing Craft) from hand to ▲ a [Presence] droid pilot (or vice versa), and deploy both simultaneously. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the release-sheet words again, word for word (no “you”, the colon and the comma back). It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (versions rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat; whatever was published last is current). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number.
